verdict.rationale: A long-time customer reports setting up 'auto-funding rules' across purpose-named accounts. That is a user-defined rule that triggers money movement automatically. First-party docs also show organization approval policies that gate payment requests automatically. Webhooks and the API are only developer building blocks for constructing automation, and fixed auto-behaviors like receipt matching and cashback are not user-defined rules, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a general rules/automation builder (event triggers, conditions, actions), documented auto-funding/sweep rule configuration, breadth of supported trigger events and actions, and hands-on corroboration beyond a single community mention.
